armor.region: segmented armor blocks on each dish tier, shoulder fittings and skull backing plinths
armor.finish: blackened cast iron with broad graphite faces and shallow edge scoring
armor.direction: plate borders follow individual armor-panel UVs
armor.wear: sparse bronze-exposed border abrasion, no all-over stripes

cast.region: Low braced U-bay landing/seat castings, open Noctilith cage and thick dished electrode bodies
cast.direction: fine stipple on frames; circumferential machining along dished stage UVs
cast.wear: edge polishing on actual bevels; recessed dish interiors stay dark

bronze.region: flange rings, emblem and fastener seats
bronze.finish: aged warm bronze with radial machining
bronze.direction: circumferential lathe UV u, axial UV v

copper.region: Four induction windings, six retained mineral-contact leads and two sealed housing feeds
copper.direction: linear winding texture along each helical cable
copper.wear: fine longitudinal draw marks; dark joints

ceramic.region: lateral induction tower isolators, inter-dish electrode standoffs and central emitter insulator

skull.region: two winged cog seals at the upper and lower casing
skull.finish: aged bronze casting over supplied unchanged DGordillo low-poly skull
skull.direction: original donor UV and sculpt normal preserved
skull.wear: fine casting mottling; no remesh or anatomical substitution

rock.region: Three distinct irregular clast groups, with actual open joints, crushed contact edges and pilot open-edge chips
rock.finish: Dielectric dark olive/charcoal angular mineral, mottled granular faces and subdued pale ochre fracture web
rock.direction: Unique model-specific UV base/normal/roughness bake; granular variation across differently oriented cleavage planes
rock.wear: Nonemissive broken mineral seams and contact pressure masks remain distinct from recessed green energized geometry
rock.current_derivative: V15b unique mineral maps retained through V17 axial re-layout; geometry/UVs now match V18g. No new mineral bake is claimed at V18.

green.region: Noctilith fractures, energized contacts and aft field collars
green.direction: fractures follow actual irregular rock edge chains
green.wear: contained electric field; no chemical combustion or heat interpretation

core_hardware.region: Continuous23cm-deep retained backing pan, two substantial inter-stone cast crossheads, fitted ceramic receivers, bolted access covers and cage load attachments
core_hardware.finish: Existing part-specific cast/armor/ceramic PBR with new actual UV islands; no flat image fill
core_hardware.mechanical_review: 390 actual canonical core through-rays blocked; external cage gaps and emitter aperture intentionally excluded

retained_hardware.region: Seated joint bolts/bearing washers/captive plates, seven insulating cable guide assemblies and two seated cast-root retention caps
retained_hardware.finish: Existing matching bronze/cast/ceramic finish; guide bores retain measurable conductor clearance
